messages:
alex: Heads up — FinBank EU is asking for a POC. They want a clear picture of jurisdictional data paths, which subprocessors touch customer data, KMS ownership options (BYOK/HSM), and an annotated data flow we can hand to their legal/security team. POC deadline: Tue EOD. Can we produce an exportable diagram + subproc CSV and a short statement about embeddings/log retention? @jess @natalie
jess: On it. Quick clarifying Qs: do they require Private (VPC/on-prem) only, or is Dedicated (reserved) acceptable if we guarantee EU-only egress and BYOK? Any specific retention/pseudonymization rules?
alex: Preference is Private/VPC but Dedicated is OK if we can pin region and provide customer-managed keys. Retention ask: 30 days for operational logs, no persistent customer traces beyond that unless they opt in. They also want to see subproc contract evidence.
jess: I'll draft a simplified data-path sketch + short BYOK/KMS note. Pinging infra for network-level details. @samir can you add a short note about runtime routing + KV cache persistence behavior for the diagram?
samir: Runtime summary: control-plane metadata (model selection, billing events) may call hosted control endpoints, but inference data plane stays in-customer (Dedicated/Private) when configured. KV cache sits on serving nodes in-region and can be configured to avoid disk persistence. Example minimal config we can show: ```deployment.mode: dedicated
region: eu-west-1
kms: customer_managed
cache.persist: false```
natalie: @alex thanks — for the security pack we should include: exported diagram (SVG/PNG), subprocessor table with roles + jurisdictions + cert links, and a control mapping for data-in-motion/at-rest protections (TLS, mTLS, VPC endpoints). Two asks: confirm (1) an approved EU-only list for storage/logging subprocessors, and (2) that no Redwood analytics touches customer content.
alex: Confirming with customer: billing logs can be exported to their S3 in eu-west-1; audit logs must remain in their tenant. They explicitly said no Redwood analytics on customer content. 👍
jess: Plan: (1) annotated data flow, (2) subproc table (name, role, country, contract link), (3) KMS options + short config examples, (4) brief statement on embeddings/cache behavior. Drafts by tomorrow noon. Any required fields for the subproc CSV we should include?
natalie: Include these columns: name, role (storage/compute/logging), country/jurisdiction, contract link (DPA/SAQ), SOC/ISO certs, data residency guarantee (yes/no), cross-border backups (yes/no), last audited date. Flag transitive providers (cloud infra) clearly.
security_bot: Incident-bot: Existing subprocessor master list available at /internal/compliance/subprocessors/2025-02-subproc-master.csv
samir: For the diagram I'll make two lanes: control-plane (blue arrows) vs data-plane (green arrows). Will sketch in Lucid and export SVG + PNG. Also note: embedding vectors may be cached in memory; we can set cache.persist=false to avoid disk persistence and ensure region pinning.
alex: Perfect. @natalie can you give final approval on the pack once drafts are in? Also customer asked explicitly: "Are embeddings ever stored outside EU?" Short answer to include: "Embeddings may be cached on serving nodes but are not persisted to external storage when cache.persist=false; region pinning prevents cross-region replication." I'll confirm the exact language.
natalie: I can approve conditionally — include an explicit non-persistence policy, export of the diagram, and the subprocessor CSV with cert links. Also add an auditable statement about the last subcontractor audit dates.
jess: Noted. I'll upload drafts to the internal share and post links here when ready: https://redwood.internal/diagrams/1728550000-jurisdictional-diagram.svg and https://redwood.internal/compliance/1728550000-subprocessors.csv. CC: @security_bot for final compliance upload.
